artifacts.name: agents-guide
artifacts.description: Authoritative project guide for agents and contributors. Project overview (canonical InfoItem + InfoSource + SourceRevision + RepSpec registry, Phase 4 / Archiver v2), full src/ and repo layout, code exploration policy, the cannobserv co-core substrate and wheelhouse workflow, content-acquisition via co-core (no cross-repo mirror discipline), env vars (ARCHIVER_DATABASE_URL, TEST_DATABASE_URL, ARCHIVER_ALLOW_PRODUCTION_DB, ARCHIVER_REDIS_URL and the redis knobs, WATCHER_BASE_URL/WATCHER_API_KEY, ARCHIVER_PUBLIC_BASE_URL), server lifecycle (port 8020=systemd, 8021=scripts/dev_server.sh), the authoring-tool and assignment endpoint tables with their archiver-client SDK wrappers, the info.changes change-bus producer contract and event versioning convention, error-envelope conventions, commit/changelog conventions, and the data-model vocabulary.

artifacts.name: readme
artifacts.description: Top-level README. Brief description of the Archiver service — sibling to watcher and notifier, consumed via the archiver-client SDK. Run-locally (wheelhouse sync + uv sync + scripts/dev_server.sh), tests, SDK regeneration, admin dashboard, and the optional change-bus publisher. Extraction history (from watcher#149), the 2026-07-18 production-write incident and the dev-server guard that closed it, and pointers to the Phase 4 / Archiver v2 design and implementation plans.

artifacts.name: skills-doc
artifacts.description: Agent skills index. Catalogues the skills under skills/ (agentskills.io) and .claude/skills/ (Claude Code). Local overrides table, vendor submodule reference (gregoryfoster/skills, obra/superpowers), the committed .skills/doctor.sh symlink doctor, SocratiCode workflow, linked-projects config (watcher+notifier).

artifacts.name: design-and-plans
artifacts.description: Archive of design and implementation plan documents — the 'why' behind each phase, including retired ones. Covers the current model (2026-05-08 Archiver v2 architecture design + Phase 4 implementation), InfoSource simplification, the current-vs-previous-primary binding model, the RepSpec document-editing ADR, error-envelope normalization, the dashboard design and UX redesign, generated-client drift detection, the observer cluster integration strategy and Replicator MVP, the archiver#72 Phase 0 cannobserv adoption, and Redis bus ownership. Also holds the retired Phase 1 / Phase 3a plans and the original Information Source Specifications design as historical context.

artifacts.name: research-trajectory
artifacts.description: Trajectory research. 2026-05-06-archiver-information-model.md argued the evolution from the retired InfoItem ↔ InfoSpec model (Phase 1–3a) to the content-addressed InfoSource + SourceSpec + SourceRevision model. That evolution has since shipped as Phase 4 / Archiver v2 — this doc is retained as the reasoning trail, not as a description of the current schema.

artifacts.name: alembic-migrations
artifacts.description: Database schema history as Alembic migrations against the `information` schema (canonical source of truth — no separate schema.sql). Current registry tables: info_items (semantic anchor, rep_fields JSONB, watcher_item_id), info_sources (url + source_specs JSONB, domain_name), source_revisions (content-addressed snapshots), rep_specs, info_item_rep_specs (effective-dated assignments), info_item_sources (the roleless item↔source binding), domains, changes_outbox (change-bus outbox with dead_lettered_at), plus app_users and api_keys for the dashboard. Also records the retirements: info_specs dropped, info_item_source_revisions dropped, the binding `role` column dropped.

artifacts.name: systemd-unit
artifacts.description: Production systemd service unit for the Archiver API. Defines how the live service on port 8020 is launched, restarted, and which env files it loads (/etc/archiver/.env). Sets ARCHIVER_ALLOW_PRODUCTION_DB=1 — the only place that does. ExecStartPre steps sync the co-core wheelhouse and run scripts/check_redis_floor.sh; ordering is soft (Wants=/After=) on redis-server, the change-bus broker Archiver operates.
